taskQueueClient.bulkExistentTaskLookupSql: select t.i1 as task_type_id, t.t1 as ticket from common_tmp t where exists (select 1 from task_queue q where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket)

taskQueueBackend.pickupTaskSql: select ticket from task_queue q where env_type_id=? and task_type_id=? and task_state_id=? and process_at_ms<=? and not exists (select 1 from task_queue_process p where p.task_type_id=q.task_type_id and p.ticket=q.ticket) limit ?
taskQueueBackend.updatePickedStatusSqlPrefix: update task_queue tq set task_state_id=?, system_process_id=?, last_ms=? from task_queue_process p where p.task_type_id=tq.task_type_id and p.ticket=tq.ticket and p.pickup_id=?
taskQueueBackend.readTaskQueueSql: select task_type_id, ticket, task_state_id, env_type_id, process_at_ms, payload, insert_ms from common_tmp t join task_queue q on (t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket)
taskQueueBackend.readTaskTextFieldSql: select task_type_id, ticket, field, value from common_tmp t join task_field_text f on (t.i1=f.task_type_id and t.t1=f.ticket)
taskQueueBackend.readTaskNumFieldSql: select task_type_id, ticket, field, value from common_tmp t join task_field_num f  on (t.i1=f.task_type_id and t.t1=f.ticket)
taskQueueBackend.deleteTaskFieldNumSql: delete from task_field_num q using common_tmp t where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket
taskQueueBackend.deleteTaskFieldTextSql: delete from task_field_text q using common_tmp t where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket
taskQueueBackend.deleteTaskErrorSql: delete from task_queue_error q using common_tmp t where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket
taskQueueBackend.deleteTaskQueueSql: delete from task_queue q using common_tmp t where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket
taskQueueBackend.deleteTaskQueueProcessSql: delete from task_queue_process q using common_tmp t where t.i1=q.task_type_id and t.t1=q.ticket
